name: Nazmul Huq
contribution: Major Nazmul Huq was the first commander of Sector 7 of the Bangladesh Liberation War.
context: Sector 7 covered a major western theatre, and Huq helped organise its early command and resistance operations before his death in September 1971.
impact: His brief command was important to the early military organisation of the liberation forces in the Rajshahi–Pabna area.
highlight: An early architect of organized resistance command.
seoDescription: Profile of Nazmul Huq, focusing on 1971 Liberation War connections, historical role, and related Bangladesh history.
shortAnswer: Nazmul Huq is linked to the 1971 Liberation War in this timeline as Pioneering Sector Commander.

faq.question: How is Nazmul Huq connected to 1971?
faq.answer: Nazmul Huq is linked to the Liberation War through the project timeline as Pioneering Sector Commander. He was among the early military organizers of sector-based resistance and helped shape wartime command.
